# kz-tax-rates — a free, cited table of Kazakhstan's simplified-regime tax rate
# per district. Crawl it, index it, and take the data.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The machine-readable copies, which are what most automated readers want.
# rates.json holds every year; rates-<year>.json holds one, same schema.
# llms.txt describes the schema in plain text.
